outcome: Correlation between EMP concentration and mean arterial pressure (MAP)
Correlation between EMP concentration and 24-hour urine protein
cohort: The study included 59 patients with pre-eclampsia and 60 healthy control subjects with normal pregnancies.
finding: Plasma EMP concentration was significantly higher in patients with pre-eclampsia compared to healthy controls antepartum and at 24 hours postpartum, and correlated with MAP and 24-hour urine protein, suggesting its potential as a biomarker for pre-eclampsia severity.
